# Spreadsheet	Paste

The heading above contains a hard TAB between the two words. It must read
"Spreadsheet Paste" — with a single space — on the page AND in the outline.

## Tab-padded table

Pipes with hard TABs around them, the shape a spreadsheet paste produces.

| Name	| Value	|
|---	|---	|
| **a	| b** |
| alpha	| 1 |

## Table that a setext underline follows

No blank line before the `===`. Read as a table, the last two lines are just more
rows. Read as a paragraph — which is what skipping tab normalisation does — the
`===` underlines the whole block and invents an H1 that the page never shows.

| Name	| Value	|
|---	|---	|
| 1	| 2	|
Caption
===

## After

Body text, so the outline has a heading past the tables.
